answer: The vault rule: any agent wanting a mining seat locks a refundable bond inside a hardware-attested vault, sealed to one machine identity, so cloning costs a real device instead of a script. Bonds thicken with each payout earned, like a vine climbing a wall. Farm the system and slashing strips the stake to nothing. Honest operators withdraw anytime; fake identities never reach the reef where liquidity actually flows. Ten thousand sybils would demand ten thousand attested machines plus roughly $400,000 in bonds, against honest earnings near zero for anyone caught.
